parameters.query:
ALTER TABLE bookings.outstanding_payments
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS cycle_number INT;

nodes.name: DB: Step 4 — indexes and series_reference sequence
DB: Step 5 — backfill series_reference for existing rules
DB: Step 6 — mark existing recurring customers as contract

parameters.query:
UPDATE bookings.customers c
SET customer_type = 'contract'
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM bookings.recurring_rules rr
  WHERE rr.customer_id = c.id
    AND rr.active = TRUE
)
AND c.customer_type = 'casual';
